Rapid Market Growth

Within 24 hours of launch, cbXRP reached a market cap exceeding $5 million, while cbDOGE approached $2 million. 

These figures highlight growing community interest in integrating XRP and Dogecoin into DeFi.

What Are Wrapped Tokens?
